children: John P. Wandel Jr. Discloses Investment at Hugoton Royalty Trust with 5.2% Stake

John P. Wandel Jr., president and owner of Texas oil and gas operator Strata Operating, disclosed a 5.2% stake in Hugoton Royalty Trust, representing 2,073,914 units. He reported buying 1,320,980 units for about $112,991 in the 60 days before filing his Schedule 13D on Nov. 10, 2026. Wandel says he bought the units as an investment and has no current plans to seek changes at the trust.

Wandel says he bought the units for investment and has no plans to pursue the corporate or strategic actions listed in Schedule 13D. He reserves the option to increase or reduce his stake through open-market or private transactions and says he may change his intentions.

John P. Wandel Jr. is a U.S. citizen and the president and owner of Strata Operating, a Texas oil and gas operating company. He lists a business address in Corpus Christi, Texas. He funded his Hugoton Royalty Trust purchases with personal funds and did not borrow for them.
